title: Fork in the Road: Reflections and Optimizations for Cold Start Latency in Production Serverless Systems
problem: Cold start latency in serverless computing degrades user experience and system efficiency; production systems require effective techniques to minimize startup overhead.
motivation: Reducing cold start latency improves user experience and resource efficiency in large-scale serverless deployments.
method: Analyzes cold start bottlenecks in production serverless systems and proposes optimizations targeting container initialization, runtime startup, and application loading.
key_novelty: Comprehensive characterization and optimization strategies for cold start latency in production serverless environments.
contributions: Analysis of cold start latency bottlenecks in production systems
Optimization strategies for container and runtime initialization
Practical techniques for reducing startup overhead
limitations: Optimizations may be environment-specific; generalization to diverse function types requires validation.
